highlights.title: A failed goal draft tells you why
highlights.text: When a bot can't draft the checks for a new goal, the Mission board says why and offers Write the checks yourself, with your words already in the form. Before, it kept saying it was drafting.

highlights.title: Write a goal's checks yourself
highlights.text: If a bot's draft fails, Write the checks yourself opens the New goal form with what you typed still in it, so you finish the goal without starting over.
